subject: MAP: Data handling & compliance - draft milestones
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@healthco.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Data handling & compliance - draft milestones

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the time today — great discussion and really appreciate how pragmatic your team is on requirements. As promised, attached is a first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the Data Handling & Compliance milestone set. Highlights in this draft:

- Milestone: Privacy & PHI handling review (what we need from HealthCo and what Redwood will provide)
- Milestone: Data retention and logging policy (proposed retention windows and audit log behavior)
- Milestone: Security evidence & DPA (SOC 2 summary, encryption/KMS details)
- Owners, target dates, and dependencies are called out for each milestone in the attached doc (20260720_HC_MAP_v1.docx).

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm the owners on your side for Security and Legal (I recorded Miguel Torres for security)
2) Please flag any hard constraints on retention (default suggestion below is 30 days for raw request logs, 90 days for aggregated metrics — open to discussion)
3) Let us know if you want Redwood to prepare a short technical one-pager for the Private deployment option focused on PHI controls.

Attachments: 20260720_HC_MAP_v1.docx, SOC2_summary.pdf, data_flow_diagram.png

If this looks good, I’ll get Aditya to draft the DPA checklist and Dev to prepare the deployment notes for the technical deep-dive call. Proposed target close date in the MAP is 2026-09-01, but we can accelerate if your compliance/legal teams can review earlier.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0183

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@healthco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Data handling & compliance - draft milestones

Thanks Marissa — quick read-through and love the structure. A few clarifying questions before we confirm owners/dates:

- PHI: Can Redwood confirm whether prompts/utterances can be excluded from logging or redacted at ingest? We need strict controls for any PHI tokens.
- Retention: 30 days for raw logs feels short for our audit requirements — what flexibility do we have (our legal may ask for 90–180 days depending on dataset classification).
- SOC2: can you share evidence of the specific control mappings for data encryption and key management? Miguel (security) will want to review.

I’ll loop in Legal if we move forward on the DPA. For now, Miguel is copied on this thread — he may follow up with a more technical list.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Director, Product & Data Governance | HealthCo
samantha.lee@healthco.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@healthco.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Data handling & compliance - draft milestones

Hi Samantha — thanks — answering inline and updating the MAP milestones below so we have clear owners and dates.

PHI / logging:
- Redwood supports redaction and selective logging at ingest. We can:
  - Disable content persistence for specified routes (no request/response tokens stored)
  - Apply deterministic or pattern-based redaction before tokenization (PII/PHI suppression)
  - Provide an isolated Private deployment option (VPC/on-prem) where logs and KV cache remain in your environment and are subject to your KMS keys.

Retention:
- Default suggestion in the MAP: 30 days for raw request logs, 90 days for aggregated metrics.
- We can extend raw retention to 90 days on a per-contract basis; this is a common ask for healthcare customers but will impact audit storage and pricing. We'll include a line item in the MAP and Aditya will propose a pricing delta if HealthCo requires 90+ days.

SOC2 / encryption / KMS:
- Attached: SOC2_summary.pdf (control mapping overview) and a data_flow_diagram.png showing where tokens are encrypted and where audit logs are emitted.
- We support customer-managed keys via KMS (AWS/GCP/Azure) and can provide evidence of envelope encryption controls.

Updated MAP milestone list (excerpt):
1) Privacy & PHI handling review
   - Owner (HealthCo): Product/Data Governance (Samantha + Miguel)
   - Owner (Redwood): Dev Engel (technical lead) & Redwood Security (Aditya owns commercial/compliance coordination)
   - Target: 2026-08-01
   - Dependencies: sample prompts, dataset classification, decision on redaction vs disable-logging
   - Success criteria: sign-off from HealthCo security on proposed redaction/config approach

2) Security evidence & DPA completion
   - Owner (HealthCo): Legal
   - Owner (Redwood): Aditya Rao
   - Target: 2026-08-15
   - Dependencies: SOC2 artifact review, executed DPA
   - Success criteria: DPA signed; security checklist accepted

3) Deployment plan (Private option + KMS)
   - Owner (HealthCo): Infra/Platform
   - Owner (Redwood): Dev Patel
   - Target: 2026-08-22
   - Dependencies: access to sample dataset, network topology, KMS key info
   - Success criteria: test deployment in staging with redaction/retention config validated

Proposed overall target close date: 2026-09-01 (aligns with MAP). If HealthCo prefers a longer retention window we can update targets — Aditya to propose pricing/credit change if needed.

Next operational asks for HealthCo: please confirm who will be the primary legal reviewer and whether you can share a small sample dataset (anonymized or synthetic) by 2026-07-25 to validate redaction.

I’ll ask Aditya to draft the DPA checklist and commercial note; Dev will assemble the Private deployment one-pager and the test plan.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOC2_summary.pdf, data_flow_diagram.png

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: HealthCo MAP - owners & immediate deliverables

Folks — quick internal note to align roles against the MAP milestones above.

- Aditya: please draft the DPA checklist and a short commercial note for the retention extension (90 days raw logs option). Also prepare the SOC2 artifacts packet we can share with HealthCo Security (redact any internal-only items). Target: initial draft by 2026-07-24 so we can share with Samantha.
- Dev: assemble the Private deployment one-pager (network/KMS/key rotation, audit logs, redaction config) and a test plan for staging. Include instructions for disabling persistence on routes and configuring pattern-based redaction. Target: 2026-07-27.
- Marissa: I’ll coordinate the MAP doc updates and schedule the security deep-dive call (suggest Wed 2026-07-28).

Please reply if any of these timelines are tight. We should have the first compliance artifacts ready before Samantha shares sample data.

-Marissa

- Retention: Legal will likely push to 90 days for raw logs for initial retention; can you have Aditya include the 90-day option (pricing delta) in the DPA checklist?
- Sample data: we can provide a small synthetic sample by 2026-07-25 for Dev to validate redaction.
- Security call: Miguel is available 2026-07-28 for a 60-minute deep-dive. Please send an invite.

If HealthCo and Redwood can align on these milestones we’re good to move forward and keep the MAP target close date around 2026-09-01.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — I’ll loop in Legal next.

Best,
Samantha
